body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled its 5M camera phone 'W600' during KES 2008, which supports HSUPA, a 3G mobile telephony protocol in the HSPA family with up-link speeds up to 5.76 Mbit/s. Adopting a 3-inch full touch LCD screen with WVGA(800*480) resolution, the W600 features Internet full browsing, T-DMB, Haptic UI and a 15.3mm-thick slim design. The W600 is expected to be available for between 800,000(KRW) and 900,000(KRW) through LG Telecom in this month, and via SKT and KTF in November.
